<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#F8FCFF"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="30" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <text x="18" y="20" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">9:41</text>
  <line x1="315" y1="17" x2="315" y2="13" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="320" y1="17" x2="320" y2="11" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="325" y1="17" x2="325" y2="9" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="330" y1="17" x2="330" y2="7" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="346" cy="14" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="349" y1="17" x2="353" y2="20" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="363" y="8" width="20" height="12" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="365" y="10" width="14" height="8" rx="2" fill="#15451F"/>
  <rect x="383" y="12" width="2" height="4" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>

  <!-- Header -->
  <rect x="0" y="30" width="390" height="58" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <g>
    <polyline points="31,58 23,65 31,72" fill="none" stroke="#15451F" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <line x1="24" y1="65" x2="42" y2="65" stroke="#15451F" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  </g>
  <text x="195" y="65" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial Rounded MT Bold, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="700" fill="#15451F">Set up your trip</text>
  <g>
    <line x1="354" y1="58" x2="366" y2="70" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="366" y1="58" x2="354" y2="70" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Progress -->
  <rect x="22" y="101" width="346" height="12" rx="64" fill="#E5E5E5"/>
  <rect x="22" y="101" width="115" height="12" rx="64" fill="#00A47D"/>
  <text x="195" y="135" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial Rounded MT Bold, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="900" fill="#6F6F70">STEP 1 OF 3</text>

  <!-- Travel illustration -->
  <circle cx="195" cy="190" r="48" fill="#D1EBF7"/>
  <circle cx="195" cy="190" r="39" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <rect x="166" y="166" width="58" height="47" rx="8" fill="#FF4B4B"/>
  <rect x="185" y="166" width="20" height="47" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <rect x="166" y="180" width="58" height="19" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="195" cy="190" r="7" fill="#1899D6"/>
  <polygon points="195,186 197,190 201,190 198,193 199,197 195,195 191,197 192,193 189,190 193,190" fill="#FFC800"/>
  <line x1="159" y1="224" x2="231" y2="224" stroke="#9DAD88" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="145" cy="225" r="5" fill="#FFC800"/>
  <circle cx="246" cy="225" r="5" fill="#00A47D"/>

  <!-- Main copy -->
  <text x="195" y="276" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial Rounded MT Bold, sans-serif" font-size="26" font-weight="700" fill="#15451F">Where are you traveling?</text>
  <text x="195" y="306" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#4B4B4C">We’ll personalize your lessons for the trip</text>
  <text x="195" y="328" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#4B4B4C">you’re planning.</text>

  <!-- Prompt card -->
  <g>
    <rect x="20" y="349" width="350" height="62" rx="14" fill="#000000" opacity="0.08"/>
    <rect x="20" y="347" width="350" height="62" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="51" cy="378" r="17" fill="#FFEF8F"/>
    <polygon points="51,366 54,375 64,375 56,381 58,390 51,385 44,390 46,381 38,375 48,375" fill="#FFC800"/>
    <text x="78" y="374" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial Rounded MT Bold, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#15451F">Travel prompt</text>
    <text x="78" y="395" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#6F6F70">Learn useful words before you go</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Destination field -->
  <text x="22" y="444" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial Rounded MT Bold, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#15451F">Destination</text>
  <rect x="20" y="454" width="350" height="58" rx="13" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="49" cy="482" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="56" y1="489" x2="63" y2="496" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <text x="76" y="488" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="17" font-weight="400" fill="#6F6F70">e.g. Paris, France</text>
  <text x="22" y="536" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#6F6F70">Enter a city or country to get trip-specific vocabulary.</text>

  <!-- Suggested destination preview -->
  <g>
    <rect x="20" y="565" width="350" height="78" rx="14" fill="#000000" opacity="0.07"/>
    <rect x="20" y="563" width="350" height="78" rx="14" fill="#DDF4FF"/>
    <rect x="38" y="580" width="52" height="38" rx="11" fill="#FF4B4B"/>
    <rect x="55" y="580" width="18" height="38" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="105" y="590" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial Rounded MT Bold, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="900" fill="#15451F">YOUR TRIP LANGUAGE</text>
    <text x="105" y="615" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial Rounded MT Bold, sans-serif" font-size="20" font-weight="700" fill="#15451F">French</text>
    <circle cx="337" cy="602" r="14" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <polyline points="332,602 336,606 343,598" fill="none" stroke="#00A47D" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Continue disabled button -->
  <g>
    <rect x="20" y="667" width="350" height="48" rx="13" fill="#D9D9D9"/>
    <text x="195" y="697" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial Rounded MT Bold, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#6F6F70">Continue</text>
  </g>
  <text x="195" y="741" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial Rounded MT Bold, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#1899D6">I’ll decide later</text>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="764" width="390" height="80" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <line x1="16" y1="764" x2="374" y2="764" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>
  <g>
    <polygon points="47,785 59,775 71,785 71,799 63,799 63,789 55,789 55,799 47,799" fill="#9DAD88"/>
    <text x="59" y="819" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial Rounded MT Bold, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#6F6F70">Home</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="137" cy="788" r="12" fill="#DDF4FF" stroke="#63C9F9" stroke-width="2"/>
    <polygon points="137,778 140,786 148,786 142,791 144,799 137,794 130,799 132,791 126,786 134,786" fill="#1899D6"/>
    <text x="137" y="819" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial Rounded MT Bold, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#1899D6">Learn</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="209" y="778" width="24" height="19" rx="9" fill="none" stroke="#9DAD88" stroke-width="2"/>
    <polygon points="217,797 221,797 218,802" fill="#9DAD88"/>
    <line x1="216" y1="787" x2="226" y2="787" stroke="#9DAD88" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="216" y1="792" x2="229" y2="792" stroke="#9DAD88" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="221" y="819" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial Rounded MT Bold, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#6F6F70">Practice</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="313" cy="783" r="7" fill="#9DAD88"/>
    <ellipse cx="313" cy="798" rx="13" ry="7" fill="#9DAD88"/>
    <text x="313" y="819" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial Rounded MT Bold, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#6F6F70">Profile</text>
  </g>
</svg>
